entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Suguru Kamoshida... Former Olympian...[n]Teacher at Shujin Academy...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Reason for turning himself in is...[n]a heavy conscience, huh...

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: The human mind doesn't change[n]that easily... let alone their natural[n]temperament.

entries.speaker: SIU Director
entries.en: Perhaps I'll have someone look into it,[n]just in case...
